description: Mount the already-built PulseZone widget into the dashboard Pulse zone slot, replacing the empty placeholder, and update the dashboard page test to verify the mount.

tasks.title: Mount PulseZone into the dashboard Pulse zone slot
tasks.spec: specs/dashboard-shell/spec.md#Requirement: Dashboard provides four zone mount-point slots
tasks.description: In DashboardPage.tsx, extend the DASHBOARD_ZONES map branch selector so that the pulse zone mounts <PulseZone /> (imported from ../../../widgets/dashboard-pulse) as children of <DashboardZone>, mirroring how the digest zone mounts DashboardDigestWidget; leave productivity as the sole bare placeholder. Then update DashboardPage.test.tsx to mock useActivityCards (at @/widgets/coder-session/model/activity-cards) with an empty view-model (activeCards: [], zeroed statusCounts, {active:0,max:0} slotUsage) so PulseZone renders its empty state, and flip the pulse slot assertions from empty-placeholder (childElementCount === 0, border-dashed) to mounted (childElementCount > 0, not border-dashed, contains pulse-empty-state), while asserting no widget leakage into the digest/productivity slots and that productivity remains the only empty placeholder.
acceptanceCriteria: DashboardPage.tsx imports PulseZone from ../../../widgets/dashboard-pulse and renders it inside the pulse DashboardZone, so the pulse slot is no longer a bare empty placeholder.
The productivity zone remains the only empty placeholder (border-dashed, childElementCount === 0); the digest zone still mounts DashboardDigestWidget unchanged.
DashboardPage.test.tsx mocks useActivityCards at the @/widgets/coder-session/model/activity-cards boundary with an empty view-model (no timer/refetch involvement).

DashboardPage.test.tsx asserts the pulse slot contains [data-testid="pulse-empty-state"] (or pulse-zone) and has childElementCount > 0 (the DashboardZone wrapper retains border-dashed unconditionally regardless of children, matching the mounted digest zone, so border-dashed is not a distinguishing assertion).
DashboardPage.test.tsx asserts no zone leakage: pulse does not contain the digest widget testid, and neither digest nor productivity contains pulse-zone/pulse-empty-state.
npm run typecheck -w packages/web passes with no errors.
npm run test:run -w packages/web passes, including the existing unchanged PulseZone.test.tsx and CompactSessionCard.test.tsx alongside the updated DashboardPage.test.tsx.
No changes are made to PulseZone or CompactSessionCard behavior, props, or internal logic; no backend/API/domain-state changes are introduced.
tasks.output: Modified packages/web/src/pages/dashboard/ui/DashboardPage.tsx (pulse branch mounts PulseZone) and packages/web/src/pages/dashboard/ui/DashboardPage.test.tsx (useActivityCards mock + flipped pulse assertions); green typecheck and web test suite.
tasks.notes: The dashboard-pulse widget is already built and fully tested (PulseZone.test.tsx / CompactSessionCard.test.tsx); all dashboard-pulse spec requirements are satisfied by existing code. This task performs only the dashboard-shell mount and its validating test update, per design.md Migration Plan (single PR, frontend-only). Mock at the useActivityCards derived view-model boundary (design D2), not the widget module, so the test still exercises the real PulseZone mount point. The pulse zone testid root is data-testid="pulse-zone"; under the empty fixture it renders the pulse-empty-state.
